class.name: PlaneVoxelGenerator
class.brief_description: A generator filling the two sides of a plane with different materials.
class.description: PlaneVoxelGenerator generates one material filling the half-space the [member normal] points into and another filling the other half-space.

members.member: The normal of the plane, pointing toward the side filled with [member material_over].
The plane's distance from the origin along [member normal], in voxels while [member normal] is a unit vector.
The material filling the half-space [member normal] points into, or [code]255[/code] to leave it undefined.
The material filling the half-space away from [member normal], or [code]255[/code] to leave it undefined.
